name: AI Agent Workflow Builder
tagline: Design, visualize and export AI agent workflows with a drag-and-drop canvas
description: AI Agent Workflow Builder is a visual design tool for creating complex multi-agent workflows. Drag and drop agent nodes, connect them with conditional logic, define tool integrations, and export your workflow as runnable code (Python/JavaScript) or JSON configuration. Perfect for building agent orchestration systems without writing boilerplate.
target_audience: AI developers, agent system architects, automation engineers
features: Pre-built agent node templates (LLM, Tool, Decision, Loop)
Conditional branching and parallel execution paths
Export to Python (LangChain, CrewAI) or JavaScript
differentiation: Focused on AI agent patterns, exports clean code, no backend required
estimated_traffic: Multi-agent systems trending, n8n AI agents popular
